63:             setattr(self, attribute_name, orig)
64: 
65:     def _more_tags(self):
66:         return copy.deepcopy(_DEFAULT_TAGS)
67: 
68:     def __sklearn_tags__(self):
69:         tags_orig = super().__sklearn_tags__()
70:         as_dict = {
71:             field.name: getattr(tags_orig, field.name)
72:             for field in fields(tags_orig)
73:         }
74:         tags = TsLearnTags(**as_dict)
75:         return tags
76: 
77: 
78: class BaseModelPackage(object):
79:     __metaclass__ = ABCMeta
80: 
81:     @abstractmethod
82:     def _is_fitted(self):
83:         """
84:         Implement this method in a subclass to check
85:         if the model has been fit.
86: 
87:         Usually implements a model specific call to
88:         sklearn.utils.validation.check_is_fitted
89: 
90:         Returns
91:         -------
92:         bool
93:         """
94:         pass
95: 
96:     def _get_model_params(self):
97:         """Get model parameters that are sufficient to recapitulate it."""
98:         params = {}
99:         for attr in dir(self):
100:             # Do not save properties
101:             if (hasattr(type(self), attr) and
102:                     isinstance(getattr(type(self), attr), property)):
103:                 continue
104:             if (not attr.startswith("__") and
105:                     attr.endswith("_") and
106:                     not callable(getattr(self, attr))):
107:                 params[attr] = getattr(self, attr)
108:         return params
109: 
110:     def _to_dict(self, output=None, hyper_parameters_only=False):
111:         """
112:         Get model hyper-parameters and model-parameters
113:         as a dict that can be saved to disk.
114: 
115:         Returns
116:         -------
117:         params : dict
118:             dict with relevant attributes sufficient to describe the model.
119:         """
120: 
121:         if not self._is_fitted():
122:             raise NotFittedError("Model must be fit before it can be packaged")
123: 
124:         d = {'hyper_params': self.get_params(),
125:              'model_params': self._get_model_params()}
126: 
127:         # This is just for json support to convert numpy arrays to lists
128:         if output == 'json':
129:             d['model_params'] = BaseModelPackage._listify(d['model_params'])
130:             d['hyper_params'] = BaseModelPackage._listify(d['hyper_params'])
131: 
132:         elif output == 'hdf5':
133:             d['hyper_params'] = \
134:                 BaseModelPackage._none_to_str(d['hyper_params'])
135: 
136:         if hyper_parameters_only:
137:             del d["model_params"]
138: 
139:         return d
140: 
141:     @staticmethod
142:     def _none_to_str(mp):
143:         """Use str to store Nones. Used for HDF5"""
144:         for k in mp.keys():
145:             if mp[k] is None:
146:                 mp[k] = 'None'
147: 
148:         return mp
149: 
150:     @staticmethod
151:     def _listify(model_params):
152:         """
153:         Convert all numpy arrays in model-parameters to lists.
154:         Used for json support
155:         """
156:         for k in model_params.keys():
157:             param = model_params[k]
158: 
159:             if isinstance(param, np.ndarray):
160:                 model_params[k] = param.tolist()  # for json support
161:             elif isinstance(param, list) and isinstance(param[0], np.ndarray):
162:                 model_params[k] = [p.tolist() for p in param]  # json support
163:             else:
164:                 model_params[k] = param
165:         return model_params
166: 
167:     @staticmethod
168:     def _organize_model(cls, model):
169:         """
170:         Instantiate the model with all hyper-parameters,
171:         set all model parameters and then return the model.
172: 
173:         Do not use directly. Use the designated classmethod to load a model.
174: 
175:         Parameters
176:         ----------
177:         cls : instance of model that inherits from `BaseModelPackage`
178:             a model instance
179: 
180:         model : dict
181:             Model dict containing hyper-parameters and model-parameters
182: 
183:         Returns
184:         -------
185:         model: instance of model that inherits from `BaseModelPackage`
186:             instance of the model class with hyper-parameters and
187:             model parameters set from the passed model dict
188:         """
189: 
190:         model_params = model.pop('model_params')
191:         hyper_params = model.pop('hyper_params')  # hyper-params
192: 
193:         # instantiate with hyper-parameters
194:         inst = cls(**hyper_params)
195: 
196:         # set all model params
197:         for p in model_params.keys():
198:             setattr(inst, p, model_params[p])
199: 
200:         return inst
201: 
202:     @classmethod
203:     def _byte2string(cls, model):
204:         for param_set in ['hyper_params', 'model_params']:
205:             for k in model[param_set].keys():
206:                 if type(model[param_set][k]) == type(b''):
207:                     model[param_set][k] = model[param_set][k].decode('utf-8')
208:         return model
209: 
210:     def to_hdf5(self, path):
211:         """
212:         Save model to a HDF5 file.
213:         Requires ``h5py`` http://docs.h5py.org/
214: 
215:         Parameters
216:         ----------
217:         path : str
218:             Full file path. File must not already exist.
